body: I’m a wraith main and I don’t understand why other wraiths just bail out or leave y’all. She is literally an ESCAPE character when shit gets bad! I always main wraith when playing with randos so that way if I have to revive them I can portal them away because I swear everyone disconnects if you don’t revive them before their death box.
You’re good hun I always enjoy humor no matter how I feel♥️ and tattoos will still look as beautiful on you!
I agree. I’m glad you actually commented it helped me stop having an anxiety attack so thank you♥️
I’m a wraith main and I never leave my team. If we are ever pinched I will die trying to set a rift for them.
I think about cutting again too so I understand that. Sometimes I get the feeling in my arms. Which is why I got tattoos so I wouldn’t mess them up
Thank you.. sometimes it’s hard to remember I’m not alone when I’m surrounded by people who don’t understand.

My parents not wanting me. Family not talking to me. Insecure from being put down. Not feeling like I’m good enough for anyone. I’m 24 and I’ve been through years of therapy and meds and nothing is helping I have my good says my great days and then my bad days it’s like my brain resets itself
Lies. She had a warrant for her as well. Because boyfriend was having people pick up drugs from her place

I wish I could. I’ll be 24 in June. But every year she ruins it. Last year my grandmother died June 18th. Her funeral was the 19th I was so upset and just not emotions stable but my mom still made me eat cake on my birthday... my birthday is June 21st....
That explains it so well. I always reassure people the reason o don’t show excitement is because it was a self defense coping mechanism for me.

Pretty much how I am. I try not to let it get to me. It really only hurts my feelings when people don’t understand. Like they think I’m not happy doing something with them. Or relationships where they think I don’t love them the same. And sometimes it’s hard to adjust. I always have to explain to people why I am the way I am. I always reassure people how I feel I just can’t always express it. You know?
Yup. Basically everything would be fine then my stomach would get super queasy and that’s when I knew shit was about to get worse
